name: Nerd Menu Icon
author: nzkritik
description: The Omarchy menu button with any Nerd Font icon in place of the logo, picked from a searchable grid of every glyph.

barWidget.description: Left click opens the Omarchy menu, right click a terminal, middle click the icon picker

schema.label: Icon code point
schema.description: Hex code point of the Nerd Font glyph, e.g. f303 for the Arch logo. Empty shows the Omarchy logo.

schema.label: Icon font
schema.description: Font family to draw the icon with. Empty uses the bar font.
